character_sheet: A cave crab-spider: a low two-block body with four ridged plates down each side and five spines along the back, a three-piece head with two eyes and a nose, a tail base with a tuft, six legs of six segments each - front, middle and back on each side - and two five-segment arms ending in a three-piece claw (ModelCaveFisher.java:100-174; 75 parts on a 64x32 sheet). It is hostile but small: 10 HP, 4 damage, 4 armour, speed 0.2 (MobStats.CAVE_FISHER, CaveFisher.java:99-107). Every eighth tick it scans 10 blocks for anything alive and in sight that is not a monster, a cave fisher, an ender reaper, an ender knight or a creative player (:136-193) and hands it to its bug melee goal (:82-83): a chase at 1.2, a bite within 2.8 blocks on 1-in-7-or-1-in-8 dice, the synched attacking flag raised in reach and cleared out of it (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:145-176, the caveFisher preset :75). It ignores cactus (:195-200), floats (:81), wanders far (:84) and spawns in darkness at or below y 50 (:223-229). Read it as a scuttling cave crab: six legs rippling in a wave, the two claws snapping up at random - rarely at rest, half the time when it hunts.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.75 of the rig (CaveFisherRenderer.java:27, 40) on a 64x32 sheet (ModelCaveFisher.java:481); the hitbox is 1.35 x 0.75 (ModEntities.java:56-58); shadow 0.35 x 0.75 (CaveFisherRenderer.java:29).

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.12 = 0.377 rad (22 deg) x the walking speed at 2.0 x 0.62, no threshold; the middle pair lags the front pair by pi/2 and the back pair by pi; the right side mirrors the left
groups.plain: the six legs sweep fore and aft in a wave running front to back, every segment of a leg together, the right side opposite the left
groups.math: a0 = cos(t * 2.0 * 0.62) * pi * 0.12 * limbSwingAmount; a1 = cos(t * 2.0 * 0.62 - pi/2) * ...; a2 = cos(t * 2.0 * 0.62 - pi) * ...; LFLeg1-6.yRot = a0; RFLeg1-6.yRot = -a0; LMLeg1-6.yRot = a1; RMLeg1-6.yRot = -a1; LBLeg1-6.yRot = a2; RBLeg1-6.yRot = -a2
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 2.0 x 0.62 (wingspeed, ModelCaveFisher.java:22): the natural period is 2 pi / 1.24 = 5.1 ticks; pi4 in the code is pi/2 (1.570795)

groups.name: claws
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg), rectified (|cos|: a lift and drop twice per natural period) on every arm segment and the claw base, the upper pincer at -0.54 and the lower at +0.35 rad on top of it; ONLY in the cycles a client-side roll picks - 2 in 20 when calm, 2 in 4 when attacking - otherwise all at 0 (pincers at their rests)
groups.plain: both arms and claws snap up together in a quick double lift, in a random tenth of the cycles at rest and half of them while hunting
groups.math: s = latch ? abs(cos(t * 3.0 * 0.62) * pi * 0.15) : 0; every ArmSeg and ClawBase .xRot = s; ClawTop.xRot = s - 0.54; ClawLow.xRot = s + 0.35 (both arms alike)
groups.phase: a per-entity latch rolled at each cycle boundary (RenderInfo ri1, ModelCaveFisher.java:536-545: nextInt(20) calm, nextInt(4) attacking; the snap plays when it lands on 1 or 3); the attacking flag only changes the odds
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 3.0 x 0.62: the natural period is 2 pi / 1.86 = 3.4 ticks, the visible lift every 1.7

behaviour: One gait wave on the six legs (ModelCaveFisher.java:495-531): the cosine of the age x 2.0 x 0.62 (wingspeed, :22), x pi x 0.12, x the walking speed yaws every segment of the left front leg one way and the right front the other; the middle pair takes the same wave a quarter period later and the back pair half a period later - a 22-degree sweep at full speed every 5.1 ticks, rippling front to back. No threshold: at a crawl the legs barely move, and they never snap to rest.

The claws snap at random (:533-552): at every boundary of the 3.4-tick claw cycle (found by comparing the cosine at the age and at the age plus 0.1) a per-entity latch rolls - nextInt(20) when calm, nextInt(4) while the synched attacking flag is up - and if it lands on 1 or 3 both arms play the snap for that cycle: the absolute value of the cosine of the age x 3.0 x 0.62 x pi x 0.15 (27 degrees) lifts all five segments of each arm and the claw base, the upper pincer holding -0.54 and the lower +0.35 rad on top (:556-577). Otherwise the arms lie flat. So the hunt reads as claws snapping five times more often, not as a different pose.
The body blocks, plates, spines, head, eyes, nose and tail never move; nothing reads the look (netHeadYaw unused), so the LookAtPlayerGoal (CaveFisher.java:85) turns nothing visible.

The attacking flag lives in the bug melee goal (CaveFisher.java:82-83 hands setAttacking to it): raised on the tick the goal finds the prey in reach and cleared on the tick it does not (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:145-176) - a held state while in reach, but the entity file itself holds no setAttacking site, so the generator's inventory reads no state here (an owner note). The bite is doHurtTarget inside the goal (:172), so the strike is transport 1.
The renderer draws it at 0.75 (CaveFisherRenderer.java:40) over a flat 1.35 x 0.75 hitbox (ModEntities.java:56-58).

extras.name: claw_snap
extras.trigger: today a client-side roll in the model, not a server call: at each 3.4-tick boundary of the claw cycle a per-entity latch rolls nextInt(20) when calm or nextInt(4) when attacking and the snap plays on a 1 or a 3 (ModelCaveFisher.java:533-552; RenderInfo ri1, CaveFisher.java:54-61); the seam needs a trigger or an idle-variant roll to play it
extras.note: one claw cycle: both arms lift 27 deg and drop twice (|cos| over 3.4 ticks) with the pincers riding on their rests (ModelCaveFisher.java:556-577) - alternatively deliver it as `idle_alt_1` (the contract's idle-variant roll, p = 0.15 per loop boundary); the owner picks which

wishlist: the claw snap is a random one-cycle event (ModelCaveFisher.java:536-552) and the seam's loops are not: keep `idle` calm and put the snap in `claw_snap` / `idle_alt_1`; in `aggro_idle` it may run every cycle (the code's odds are 1 in 2 there)
in `walk`: articulate the legs - the six segments of each leg turn as one rigid unit (ModelCaveFisher.java:496-531); a lift of the foot segments as the leg swings forward makes a real scuttle
in `attack`: the bite (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:172) has no pose today - a lunge with both claws slamming down on the impact frame, the head dipping
in `idle`: the body, head and tail never move - a slow breath of the two body blocks and a twitch of the tail tuft
in `hurt`: a rear-back with the claws thrown up
